title: Neighbor notable coordinate bound
statement: Let $G$ be a regular unique game with label set $ in q$, and assign to each vertex a function on the Boolean cube taking values in $[-1,1]$. If $0<ε≤1$, then at every vertex the number of coordinates whose stable influence in the averaged neighbor function exceeds $ε$ is at most $1/ε^2$.
hypotheses_covered: A bounded cube function is given at every vertex
